blocks.text: Penicillins bactericidal antibiotics ka group hain jo Penicillium phaphoond se hasil hoti hain. Yeh bacterial cell wall banna rok kar bohat se bacterial infections ka ilaaj karti aur Gram-positive bacteria, jin mein streptococcal aur staphylococcal infections shamil hain, ke khilaf bohat mo'assar hain. Penicillin Alexander Fleming ne 1928 mein daryaft ki. Aam zimni asraat mein matli, ulti, dast, pait dard aur jild par daane shamil hain.

items: Yeh bacteria ko nishana banati hai kyunke janwaron ke cells mein woh cell wall nahi jis par dawa asar karti hai.
Yeh peptidoglycan (murein) zanjeeron ke aapas mein jurne ko rok kar nayi cell wall banna rokti hai.
Kamzor wall cell ko thaam nahi sakti aur woh phat jata hai (lysis), is liye penicillin bacteria ko sirf rokti nahi balke maarti hai.
Kuch bacteria beta-lactamases jaise enzymes bana kar is ka muqabla karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Penicillin insani cells ke liye bezarar kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh bacterial cell wall par asar karti hai, aur insani (janwar) cells ki cell wall nahi hoti.

items: Penicillin: Penicillium se (Fleming, 1928); bactericidal; Gram-positive ke khilaf behtareen.
Peptidoglycan ke jor rok kar cell phaarti; beta-lactamases muzahimat dete.
